claims: Ben McCollum is the head men's basketball coach at the University of Iowa.
Ben McCollum was hired as the head men's basketball coach at the University of Iowa in March 2025.
Ben McCollum led the Hawkeyes to the Sweet 16 in the 2025-26 season.
Ben McCollum led Iowa to their first Sweet 16 appearance since 1999 in the 2025-26 season.
Ben McCollum was the head coach at Northwest Missouri State for 15 seasons.
Ben McCollum won four DII titles at Northwest Missouri State.
Ben McCollum was head coach at Drake for one season.
Jan Jensen was named the head women's basketball coach at the University of Iowa in May 2024.
Fran McCaffery coached the University of Iowa men's basketball team from 2010 to 2025.
Ben McCollum replaced Fran McCaffery as the head men's basketball coach at the University of Iowa.
